start_session.note: Native project sessions return a bounded composition and layer summary by default. Use get_project_state for paged detail, or detail:"full" to include the full agent project snapshot in this reply. The tool schemas are in tools/list and the on-disk API pack, not in the reply.

export_video.note: Use background:true (or wait:false) to checkpoint the session's edits, capture the current revision and return a jobId immediately. Read export_status with that jobId for progress and the output path; pass it as taskId to task_cancel to stop the export. Without an opt-in, wait:true is the default, and export_video with only a jobId resumes the legacy wait.

apply_commands.note: Replies are compact by default: per-command index and ok (or error message), newIds, changedLayerIds and revision. Set verbose:true for legacy command data and full layer results. Set atomic:false to skip invalid commands and apply the successful commands together as one undo step; the default atomic:true rejects the entire batch on any error.

task_cancel.note: You can also pass an export jobId as taskId to request cancellation. Read export_status to confirm a terminal outcome.

tools.name: export_status
tools.description: Read a recent export started for the attached project. Returns running progress when available, cancelling until cancellation is reaped, cancelled or failed with a diagnostic, or done with the output path. Poll sparingly; status does not consume the result.
